searchText: hello, Erigon team member here, i am trying to connect erigon to pithos to test out the progresses done so far, but apparently there are no peers online for reference: https://eth2.ethernodes.org/ That's obsolete information. https://github.com/eth-clients/merge-testnets/tree/main/merge-devnet-2 shows the current merge testnet information. Hi all, anyone know of a resource that explains the primary risks of the merge? Maybe a transcript of a dev meeting on the topic? I've found great Q&A's dispelling *mis*conceptions. Hoping for something that explains the actual things devs are thinking about
